recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If MedicationKnowledge is restored to active core or storage guidance is needed in the external FormularyItem/PHX artifact, make that change in the active owning artifact under a new current-scope decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 Pharmacy change request asking for structured storage guideline data elements on MedicationKnowledge, with the Jira resolution calling for a new storage information backbone.
initial_application: Commit d61b35bbd4e574c019f315e930d78e4341cde26a added MedicationKnowledge.storageGuideline and its reference, note, stabilityDuration, and environmentalSetting children to source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml. The R5 published profile includes the storageGuideline element family.
additional_context: FHIR-34413 later names MedicationKnowledge.storageGuideline as the place for storage information, supporting the applied element name despite the FHIR-34415 resolution wording. FHIR-50845 later agreed to remove MedicationKnowledge and move applicable content to FormularyItem or other resources, and commit 5a4307d78b0209f61bbc68d582c1e190b3aaee5c removed MedicationKnowledge from active source/fhir.ini registration. Related FormularyItem/module migration audits for FHIR-51149 and FHIR-53486 are already present on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The requested storage structure was already applied and published, and current core source does not actively build MedicationKnowledge, so editing the inactive MedicationKnowledge source would not fix the current specification.
